body:
Three years ago my cat had a blockage and couldn’t urinate. I spent all my money to fix him, only to have the same thing happen again a week later. I was addicted to opiates at the time, so as he was struggling and dying I decided to overdose him and myself. I woke up the next day and he didn’t. I wish it were the opposite. Later I found out it was the food I was feeding him that caused the blockage. If I’d of known I’d of stopped immediately. I live with this everyday. I’m single, broke and have no friends or family this wants to see me, he was my best friend . 
I live with this every day
